NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 6 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 18 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 16, 9:43 AM ET

Puka Nacua is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 6 DraftKings main slate at 21.9 DraftKings points for $8,100, against Arizona. Drake London (19.3, $7,000) and Chris Olave (17.8, $7,600) are next.

Drake London returns the most per dollar among wide receivers projected for at least 9 points: 2.75 projected points per $1,000 at $7,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 16, 9:43 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 6

Puka Nacua, LAR vs ARI ($8,100)

Puka Nacua carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 21.9 DraftKings points at $8,100, the 4th-highest on the entire main slate. That is 2.6 points clear of Drake London. The model gives him 9.1 targets on 27.4 routes. The salary works out to 2.70 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 28 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations Nacua averaged 21.8 points with a simulated floor of 9.6 and a ceiling of 42.7, and he holds 32% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 12.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 32 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Drake London, ATL vs CHI ($7,000)

Drake London projects 2nd at the position with 19.3 DraftKings points at $7,000. The model gives him 7.8 targets on 24.0 routes. The salary works out to 2.75 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 28 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations London averaged 19.3 points with a simulated floor of 7.9 and a ceiling of 39.1, and he holds 30% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 1.5-point underdog at home against Chicago, with an implied team total of 25 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Chris Olave, NO at NYG ($7,600)

Chris Olave projects 3rd at the position with 17.8 DraftKings points at $7,600. The model gives him 9.4 targets on 35.9 routes. The salary works out to 2.34 projected points per $1,000, 9th of 28 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations Olave averaged 17.8 points with a simulated floor of 6.5 and a ceiling of 38.3, and he holds 14% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. New Orleans is a 1.5-point favorite on the road against the Giants, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 45.5.

Value: Xavier Worthy, KC vs LAC ($4,600)

Xavier Worthy projects for 12.0 DraftKings points at $4,600, which works out to 2.60 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 28 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 7.5 targets on 26.3 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Worthy averaged 12.0 points with a simulated floor of 4.9 and a ceiling of 23.9, and he holds 17% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is a 7.5-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 24.5 in a game totaled at 41.5.
